type: extend the preflight audit with a near-degenerate tier and validate it

new_flags.NEAR_DEGENERATE: evaluation std below a threshold fraction of training std
new_flags.DOMINATED_ON_EVAL: one level above 0.95 on evaluation while below 0.80 in training

clean_design.note: no false positive, which is the property that matters most

honest_caveat.what: both constructed cases fired the dominance branch, so the ratio branch was never executed
honest_caveat.why: zeroing 99 percent of a column also makes it dominated, and that rule fires first
honest_caveat.what_would_exercise_it: a column that keeps its spread but shrinks in scale, for example a continuous feature multiplied by 0.01 on the evaluation set
honest_caveat.status: the tool is one branch validated and one branch untested

value_and_risk.value: catches the near-degenerate shape that exact criteria miss
value_and_risk.risk: a check that cries wolf gets ignored, so the clean_design PASS is the most important result of this round

limits: The constructed cases are artificially injected.
The 0.05, 0.95 and 0.80 thresholds are chosen rather than optimised.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim.

scope_declaration.note: changes are under research/tools/, not src/ or the root tools/
